rules.exact: SHA-256 of whitespace-collapsed text, no case folding
rules.same_protocol: jaccard >= 0.85, or jaccard >= 0.5 with equal normalized titles
rules.keeper: most protected split (test > dev > train), then lowest protocol number

duplicate_copy_agreement.definition: Byte-identical duplicate texts annotated separately in the release. Entities match on (label, start, end); relations on (head span, label, tail span). Annotator identity is unknown, so this is duplicate-copy agreement, not inter-annotator agreement.
